json.title: Everyday Chinese, one phrase at a time
我们做什么
json.content: 我们收集日常生活中真正用得上的中文表达，配上拼音和分类，整理成一份大家都能查的词汇表。每个词条都由成员提交，经过审核后加入。

json.title: What we do
json.content: We collect the Chinese phrases people actually use day to day, add pinyin and a category, and keep them in a glossary anyone can look through. Entries are submitted by members and reviewed before they go in.

json.title: 欢迎加入
json.content: 不管你是母语者还是刚开始学中文，都可以参加。我们定期见面聊天、整理词条，也欢迎你直接提交自己听到的说法。

json.title: Everyone is welcome
json.content: Native speakers and beginners alike. We meet regularly to talk and to sort through new entries, and you can submit a phrase you picked up somewhere at any time.

definitions.en: Hello - the standard greeting, safe in any situation.
Hello, polite form. Use with elders, teachers and strangers.
definitions.de: Hallo, höfliche Form. Für Ältere, Lehrer und Fremde.

definitions.en: What are you up to? Casual, between friends.
Have you eaten? Used as a friendly greeting, not a real question.
So-so, nothing special. Literally "horse horse tiger tiger".
definitions.de: Geht so, nichts Besonderes. Wörtlich "Pferd Pferd Tiger Tiger".

definitions.en: Keep going, you can do it. Shouted at races and exams alike.
Whatever you like, up to you. Common when nobody wants to choose.
Damn. Mild but impolite - not for the office.
No problem / never mind. Answer to an apology or a thank you.
definitions.de: Kein Problem / macht nichts. Antwort auf eine Entschuldigung oder Dank.

definitions.en: Sorry / excuse me. Softer than a formal apology.
